title: Strong tensor constraint compatible with the global counit
statement: For a scheme X, an evaluation equivalence e from modules on its global sections point to Γ(X,O_X)-modules, an additive functor P given on objects and maps by inverse image of e.inverse followed by change of rings along toGlobalSectionsPoint X, and any adjunction P ⊣ Γ(X,-), there exists a strong monoidal structure on P whose tensor constraint composed with P of the concrete section tensor map and the counit at M tensor N equals the tensor of the counits at M and N for every pair of O_X-modules. The point, inverse image, change of rings and section tensor map are those of def-pc-global-derived-rhom, lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation and lem-sc-module-cup-naive-map-chain.

source.place: Modules Lemma 17.16.4 (cited by 079U); Tags 008A/008Y for the pullback adjunction; Tag 0FKU for the section tensor map

proof.text: Install the concrete global-sections lax structure. The mate isomorphisms give invertible components of the adjunction-induced oplax structure. Apply Mathlib Functor.Monoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal, whose tensorator is the inverse oplax component, then Adjunction.map_μ_comp_counit_app_tensor and cancel the inverse to obtain exactly the counit normalization.

theorem globalTensorPullback_monoidal_normalization
    (e : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (globalSectionsPoint X)) ≌
        ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
      (he : Nonempty (e.functor ≅ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (globalSectionsPoint X)))
      (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (h : ∀ M, P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
          X.toRingedSpace.sheaf (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf
            ⟨(toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
          (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M)))
      (hm : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N), P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫
        SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
          (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            X.toRingedSpace.sheaf (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf
              ⟨(toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.c⟩)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M))
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M) (e.inverse.map a)) ≫
          eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [P.Additive]
    (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) :
    ∃ mon : P.Monoidal,
      letI := mon
      ∀ M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace),
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ P
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj M)
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj N) ≫
          P.map (moduleCup_sectionTensorMap X M N) ≫ adj.counit.app (M ⊗ N) =
        adj.counit.app M ⊗ₘ adj.counit.app N
